name: Okuda Midori
source:
"You already know Youko-san. We're going out for the day, so let's get along."

She cares for Erena, who has no idea what she is doing.

She is mischievous like a girl of her age, but she also has a pious side, as she never misses her daily prayers.

[Translated from [url=https://www.otomate.jp/chouchoujiken/chara/index8.php]official website[/url]]
